blocks.prompt: 7 (i) A quantity changes according to \(N = 500e^{kt}\). If \(N = 250\) when \(t = 5\), find: the value of constant \(k\).
blocks.explanation:
Miqdaar 500 se 250 ho gayi, yani 5 units waqt mein aadhi reh gayi. Is liye yeh decay hai aur \(k\) negative aana chahiye.
Diya kya hai? \(N = 500e^{kt}\), aur \(t = 5\) par \(N = 250\).
Find kya karna hai? Constant \(k\).
Rule kaunsa? Exponential ko akela kar ke \(\ln\) lena; aur \(\ln\frac{1}{2} = -\ln 2\).
Plan: values rakhna, 500 se divide, \(\ln\) lena, aur 5 se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 500e^{kt}\); \(t = 5\) par \(N = 250\).
Maloom karna: constant \(k\).
Tareeqa: \(e^{5k}\) ko akela kar ke \(\ln\) lenge, kyunke \(k\) power mein hai.

\(t = 5\) aur \(N = 250\) rakhein
\[250 = 500e^{5k}\]
Kyun: yeh jora model ko poora karta hai.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{1}{2} = e^{5k}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 500 se divide kiya: \(\frac{250}{500} = \frac{1}{2}\). Yahin se pata chal gaya ke 5 units mein miqdaar aadhi hoti hai.

\(k\) nikaalein
\[k = -\dfrac{\ln 2}{5}\]
\[= -\dfrac{0.693147}{5}\]
\[\approx -0.13863\]
Kyun: dono taraf 5 se divide kiya. \(k\) negative aaya, decay ke mutabiq.
Dhyan dein: exact jawab \(k = -\frac{\ln 2}{5}\) sambhaal kar rakhiye; part (ii) mein yahi kaam aayega.

blocks.prompt: 7 (ii) A quantity changes according to \(N = 500e^{kt}\). If \(N = 250\) when \(t = 5\), find: the quantity \(N\) when \(t = 10\).
blocks.explanation:
Part (i) se \(k\) maloom ho chuka hai. Ab unknown \(N\) hai, jo power mein nahi, is liye logarithm ki zaroorat nahi.
Diya kya hai? \(N = 500e^{kt}\), \(k = -\frac{\ln 2}{5}\), aur \(t = 10\).
Find kya karna hai? \(t = 10\) par miqdaar \(N\).
Rule kaunsa? Seedha substitution; saath mein \(a\ln x = \ln(x^{a})\) aur \(e^{\ln x} = x\).
Plan: exact \(k\) istemal karenge, taa ke \(10k = -2\ln 2\) bane aur jawab bilkul saaf nikle, rounding ke baghair.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 500e^{kt}\), \(k = -\frac{\ln 2}{5}\) (part (i) se), \(t = 10\).
Maloom karna: \(t = 10\) par \(N\).
Tareeqa: values rakh kar calculate karna. Rounded \(k\) ke bajaye exact \(k\) lenge, kyunke is se rounding ki ghalti nahi aati.

\(10k\) nikaalein
\[10k = 10 \times \left(-\dfrac{\ln 2}{5}\right)\]
\[= -2\ln 2\]
Kyun: power mein \(kt = 10k\) aayega, to pehle wohi nikal liya. 10 aur 5 ka cancel ho kar 2 bacha.

Values rakhein
\[N = 500e^{-2\ln 2}\]
\[= 500e^{\ln(2^{-2})}\]
Kyun: logarithm ka power law: \(a\ln x = \ln(x^{a})\). Is liye \(-2\ln 2 = \ln(2^{-2})\).

Simplify karein
\[N = 500 \times 2^{-2}\]
\[= 500 \times \dfrac{1}{4} = 125\]
Kyun: \(e\) aur \(\ln\) ek doosre ko khatam karte hain: \(e^{\ln x} = x\). Aur \(2^{-2} = \frac{1}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: \(2^{-2}\) ko \(-4\) samajhna ghalat hai; negative power ka matlab ulta (reciprocal) hai.

Tasdeeq
Rounded value se bhi: \(500e^{-1.3863} \approx 500 \times 0.25 = 125\).
Ek aur nazar se: miqdaar har 5 units mein aadhi hoti hai, to 10 units mein do dafa aadhi: \(500 \to 250 \to 125\) \(\checkmark\) Teeno tareeqe ek hi jawab dete hain.
